Pham vi ditu chinh, doi ttnyng tip dung
1. Th8ng tir nay quy dinh ve lien ket to chirc thi cap chimg chi nang lac ngoai ngir cua nuac ngoai, bao DOi Wong lien ket to chirc thi; chimg, chi nang luc ngoai nuac ngoai; bao dam an toan, chat hrong trong lien ket to chirc thi; trach nhiem bao dam an toan, chat prong trong lien ket to chirc thi va trach nhiem cua the co quan quail 1.y.
2. Thong tir nay tip dung d6i a) Co so gido chic, dao tao hoc -CO chirc &roc thanh lap va hoat d8ng hop phap trong hmh vgc giao duc tai Viet Nam (sau day pi la co so. to chirc thi tai Viet Nam); b) Co quan, to chirc, co so danh gia nang lac ngoai ngir dirge thanh rap va hoat dOng hop phap d nu& ngodi (sau day goi la co so clanh gia nang luc ngoai ngu nuOc ngoai); c) Cac to chirc va ca nhan có lien quan den hoat d8ng lien ket to chirc thi cap chimg chi nang luc ngoai ngit cua nuac ngodi tai Viet Nam. Dieu 2. Giai thich tir ngir Trong Thong tu nay, cac tit ngit clued day duac hien nhu sau:
1. Dan vi cap chting chi ming hrc ngoai ngii.' ciia nu& nrai la ca so danh gia rang Arc ngoai ngir mac ngoai có trach nhi'em va tham quyen cap chimg chi nang luc ngoai ngil dm nuac ngoai. ‘2. Dan vi lien k't to chirc thi la co sa to chirc thi tai Viet Nam có thoa thuan hoac hop gon g hop tac vai ca so danh gia nang luc ngoai ngil mot ngodi, chiu trach nhiem chinh trong viec to chirc thi cap chimg chi nang luc ngoai ngit dia mac ngoai tai Viet Nam.
3. Don vi phai hop to chirc thi la ca sa to chirc thi tai Viet Nam co van ban thoa thuan hoac hop gong hop the vai dan vi lien ket to chirc thi de bao dam met hoac met so viec: clang lcSr dix thi, cong cap dia diem, ca so vat chat, thiet bi, do, i ngii nhan su. Ditu 3. Diii ttrtrng lien ke't to chtic thi Doi tuang lien ket to chirc thi la cac ben lien ket, gem:
1. Ben Viet Nam la don vi lien Vet to chirc thi quy dinh tai khoan 2 Dieu 2 dm Thong tir nay.
2. Ben nuac ngoai la don vi cap chimg chi nang luc ngoai ngit oh nuac ngoai quy dinh tai khoan 1 Dieu 2 cita Thong tu nay hoac ca so danh gia nang Arc ngoai ngir nix& ngodi dirge don vi cap chirng chi nang luc ngoai ngir ciia nu& ngoai by quyen hoac cho phep to chirc thi cap chirng chi. Dieu 4. Chting chi nang luc ngoai ngir ciia nu*c ngoai
1. Chung chi nang lac ngoai ngil ciia nuac ngoai la van ban xac nhan ket qua thi nang luc ngoai ngil do don vi cap chirng chi nang luc ngoai ngir cita nuac ngodi cap cho nguai du thi. Ching chi nang luc ngoai ngir dm nuac ngodi khong phai la chirng chi ciia N thong gido due quec dan.
2. Ching chi nang luc ngoai ngil dm nuac n4odi khong bao gem chimg chi danh gia nang luc hoc tap cac mon hoc khae bang tieng nuac ngoai hoac chimg chi danh gia nang luc trong linh vue chuyen mon de hanh nghe bang tieng nuac ngoai.
3. Ching chi nang luc ngoai ngir dm nuac ngoai dirge cong nhan hop phapp nuac so tai khi dtrac ca quan co than quyen dm nu& do cho phep to chirc thi cap chirng chi; hoac duac sir dung de xet duyet ho so nhap cu, nhap quoc tich, cap thi thuc nhap canh cho cong dan cac nu& có nhu cau dinh cu, lam viec, nghien ciru, hoc tap, cong nhan dat chuan dau vao, dau ra trong chuong trinh dao tao doi vai sinh vien quec to tai nuac sir dung ngon ngir duot thi cap chimg chi la ng8n ngir chinh thirc.
4. Chung chi nang luc ngoai ngir cita nuac ngoai có gia tri sir dung pile, bien tren the giai khi duac nhieu mrac cong nhan hoac s* dung theo quy dinh tai khoan 3 Dieu nay hoac dirge to chirc thi cap chirng chi tai nhieu nuac tren the giai.
5. Viec phe duyet lien ket to chirc thi cap chimg chi nang Arc ngoai ngir dm nuac ngodi khong bao gem viec cong nhan de cap dO ciia chimg chi na Arc ngoai 1, jg ngu do tuong throng \Tod caerbac cua Khung nang Arc ngoai ngir 6 bac diing cho Viet Nam de sir dung trong he thong giao duc quoc dan.
